title: Learning Penalty for Changepoint Detection via Automatic Feature Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2505.07413v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Changepoint detection identifies significant shifts in data sequences, making it important in areas like finance, genetics, and healthcare. The Optimal Partitioning algorithms efficiently detect these changes, using a penalty parameter to limit the changepoints count. Determining the optimal value for this penalty can be challenging. Traditionally, this process involved manually extracting statistical features, such as sequence length or variance to make the prediction. This study proposes a novel approach that uses recurrent networks to learn this penalty directly from raw sequences by automatically extracting features. Experiments conducted on 20 benchmark genomic datasets show that this novel method generally outperforms traditional ones in changepoint detection accuracy.

translated_title: 通过自动特征提取学习变点检测的惩罚参数
translated_abstract: 变点检测用于识别数据序列中的显著变化，在金融、遗传学和医疗保健等领域具有重要应用。最优分割算法能够高效地检测这些变化，其通过一个惩罚参数来限制变点的数量。然而，确定该惩罚参数的最优值往往具有挑战性。传统方法需要人工提取统计特征（如序列长度或方差）来进行预测。本研究提出了一种新颖的方法，利用循环网络自动提取特征，直接从原始序列中学习该惩罚参数。在20个基准基因组数据集上进行的实验表明，这种新方法在变点检测精度方面普遍优于传统方法。
tldr: 该研究提出利用循环网络自动提取特征，直接从原始序列中学习变点检测的最优惩罚参数，在20个基因组基准数据集上的实验表明其检测精度普遍优于依赖人工特征提取的传统方法。
en_tdlr: This study proposes using recurrent networks to automatically extract features and learn the optimal penalty for changepoint detection directly from raw sequences, achieving better detection accuracy than traditional manual feature-based methods across 20 benchmark genomic datasets.
